records.issue: FinOps guidance prefers alerts and continuity-aware stopping, while the agent checklist requires stop-at-limit for hard caps. Flattening either statement into a universal policy would lose its condition.
records.proposed_resolution: Preserve two distinct, explicitly chosen policy profiles: an intended hard financial ceiling requires effective stopping; an alert-led continuity profile requires accountable response and does not claim a hard ceiling. The checklist's for-hard-caps condition makes these compatible when scope is retained.
records.scope: Authorized AI-credit and agent-related financial policy; source vendor configuration assertions remain dated and require current authoritative verification before a binding is adopted.
records.retained_alternatives: Continuity-first alerting is not a hard cap, and a configured numeric budget is not proof that spending is prevented. Workflow approximate-credit limits remain separately defined.
records.required_evidence: Explicit profile decision, exact target and budget scope, effective stop/alert setting readback, actual boundary behavior and accountable response evidence; no budget or paid-feature changes are authorized by this reconciliation.

records.issue: Line 113 says available budget at another scope will not be blocked; lines 668-669 say remaining capacity cannot override an exhausted applicable budget. Budget-balance availability and permission to consume must not be conflated.
records.proposed_resolution: Retain the ambiguous assertion as unresolved product semantics rather than infer a fail-open fallback. Consult the linked authoritative budget-evaluation specification and verify all applicable scopes before operational adoption.
records.scope: Concurrent user, cost-center, organization and enterprise budget controls; distinguish included versus metered consumption and scope-exclusion choices.
records.retained_alternatives: Unused balance can remain at a separate scope without granting permission to continue consumption blocked by another applicable control. The original ambiguous statement is preserved in its source reference, not silently corrected.
records.required_evidence: Current authoritative evaluation sequence and scoped runtime/readback evidence; neither article prose nor a sample cost-center total proves effective enterprise-wide spending prevention.

records.issue: Source calls a six-character commit reference immutable while other examples use mutable tags.
records.proposed_resolution: Use the full commit object ID for third-party action identity verification; do not certify abbreviated references or tags as immutable dependencies.
records.scope: Third-party and reusable action dependency integrity; local action content still requires its own provenance and execution review.
records.retained_alternatives: Version tags may convey release intent but do not satisfy immutable identity alone.

records.issue: Illustrative script prints successful test and coverage numbers without executing the corresponding test predicate.
records.proposed_resolution: Require observed command exit status and authoritative test output; printed sample numbers are non-evidence.
records.scope: All test, coverage and acceptance receipts; provider acceptance remains distinct from mocks and local checks.
records.retained_alternatives: Example workflows remain documentation data, not executable verified bindings.

records.issue: Four productivity measurement zones can be conflated with four framework layers or five assessment pillars.
records.proposed_resolution: Preserve quality, velocity, developer happiness and business outcomes as measurement zones; retain other taxonomies separately.
records.scope: Measurement profiles, reports and denominators; no category is a substitute for reviewed source coverage.
records.retained_alternatives: Framework layers and pillar organization remain separate source structures.

records.issue: Repository declarations do not uniquely describe mixed Covenant, SustainOSS and adapter expression.
records.proposed_resolution: Preserve component grants and attributions; evaluate adapted SustainOSS expression against its historical CC BY-SA declaration instead of relabeling the whole file MIT or CC BY.
records.scope: jlcanovas conduct-template copying or adaptation; independently authored policy remains separately reviewed.
records.retained_alternatives: Reference-only use without upstream expression is not blanket permission to copy inherited templates.
